artifact_kind: experimental freeze. Written BEFORE any stopping rule is implemented. The three rules below are HYPOTHESES, not recommendations.

definitions.observed_frontier: What the CURRENT readings say is non-dominated. REPRESENT has this concept today; `decide_promotion` computes it.
definitions.terminally_resolved_set: The candidates for which the search has enough evidence to rule out a later reversal. REPRESENT does NOT have this concept, and this rung is about what it would take to.

THE_CONTRACT: A search may stop only when every candidate capable of changing the terminal preference has sufficient evidence. A unique preference among current observations is not itself sufficient evidence to terminate.
WHY_THIS_IS_THE_NEXT_RUNG_AND_NOT_REALIZ: DEPTH-2 stopped the COMPARATOR letting measurement choices decide. A terminal condition that fires on a winner nobody priced lets the SEARCH do it instead — the same defect one layer out. Improving the accuracy of physical cost while the search can still stop on a policy-dependent answer would be improving the wrong thing first.

THE_HEADLINE_WITNESS_already_in_hand.what: The 210 replicates in the FRONTIER-SPEND-1 rerun that terminated on a cheaply-measured winner.
THE_HEADLINE_WITNESS_already_in_hand.the_mechanism_concretely: `frontier_spend_tests::truth()` builds 15 mutually non-dominated candidates and then appends ONE that dominates all of them — index c15, true kl 2.5e-3 and 1000 route flips. In the divergent replicates, coverage selected c15 with `dominated: [c00..c14]`, while uniform stopped on c00. Under its NOISY cheap reading the true dominator looked dominated, left uniform's observed frontier, and thereby escaped any stopping rule phrased over that frontier.
THE_HEADLINE_WITNESS_already_in_hand.why_it_is_the_right_headline: It is not a hypothetical. The mechanism was produced by a driver that was frozen before the defect was known, and the candidate that escaped is the one the generator planted as the answer.

A_WARNING_RECORDED_SO_IT_CANNOT_BE_MISRE.the_number: The DEPTH-2 rerun reported 0 H2 violations among the 534 replicates where BOTH searches priced their winner.
A_WARNING_RECORDED_SO_IT_CANNOT_BE_MISRE.the_warning: That is a CONDITIONED SUBSAMPLE and is NOT evidence that winner-only confirmation works. The condition selects for searches that ran longer before terminating — precisely the ones most likely to have stumbled onto the truth. As a STOPPING RULE the trajectory would differ, and a search that prices its apparent winner while every rival stays noisy can still stop on c00.
A_WARNING_RECORDED_SO_IT_CANNOT_BE_MISRE.obligation: No arm of this rung may cite 0/534 as a prior for rule 1. Rule 1 is tested as a stopping rule, from scratch.

THE_THREE_RULES_as_hypotheses.R1_winner_only: Price the apparent winner, then re-decide. Stop if it still leads.
THE_THREE_RULES_as_hypotheses.R2_observed_frontier: Price every member of the current observed frontier, then re-decide.
THE_THREE_RULES_as_hypotheses.R3_competitive_set: Price every candidate not safely excludable under a known uncertainty bound.
THE_THREE_RULES_as_hypotheses.stance: None is recommended. The experiment determines the CHEAPEST rule that produces policy-independent terminal preference, and it may determine that none of the three does.

THE_REQUIRED_NOISE_SWEEP.why: R3 needs a bound on how far a cheap reading can move, and the harness's bound is a constant INVENTED for FRONTIER-SPEND-1: +/- 1.0e-3 on kl and +/- 500 route flips. It is calibrated to nothing.
THE_REQUIRED_NOISE_SWEEP.the_scale_of_it: The planted front spans kl 3.0e-3 to 4.4e-3 — a spread of 1.4e-3 — so the kl noise is roughly 1.4x the ENTIRE spread it perturbs. That is very noisy, and nothing justifies it beyond its having been the first number chosen.
THE_REQUIRED_NOISE_SWEEP.the_arm: Sweep the noise magnitude across at least a decade below and a factor above the current constant, and report each rule's sufficiency and cost at each level.
THE_REQUIRED_NOISE_SWEEP.what_it_decides: If the RANKING of the rules is stable across noise levels, the conclusion transfers. If R2 suffices at low noise and fails at high, then the answer depends on a number somebody made up, and THAT dependency is the result.

THE_LIKELY_SYSTEM_LEVEL_CONCLUSION_state: In the synthetic harness, competitive-set stopping is testable because the generator supplies a known noise bound. In production REPRESENT no corresponding uncertainty bound exists: `TailSupport` establishes SUPPORT ADEQUACY — whether a percentile has enough observations behind it — not an INTERVAL on how far a cheap reading may move. TERMINAL-1 may therefore conclude that safe stopping requires a missing uncertainty-calibration capability rather than identify a deployable stopping policy. That is a good possible result, not a failed rung.

NO_ECONOMY_EXPECTATION.rule: The 4.3x saving from the DEPTH-2 rerun is NOT preregistered as something to preserve.
NO_ECONOMY_EXPECTATION.why: It was measured under a stopping rule this rung exists to question. If safe stopping requires pricing nearly everything, the economy shrinks or vanishes — and that would be the more important result, because it would mean the ladder's saving was always partly an artifact of stopping too early.
NO_ECONOMY_EXPECTATION.what_is_measured_instead: Whatever authority economy remains under the cheapest rule that actually yields policy-independent terminal preference.

METRICS: for each rule and each noise level: policy-independence of the TERMINAL preference (the primary outcome)
authority spend under each rule, in priced runs and position-equivalents
how often the terminal preference differs from the TRUE dominator the generator planted
how often a candidate that left the observed frontier under cheap evidence would have won under deep evidence — the c15 mechanism, counted
sensitivity of the rule RANKING to noise magnitude
INHERITED: DEPTH-2's contract holds throughout: heterogeneous measurement depth must not change the comparator's preference. FRONTIER-SCALE-1's falsifiers continue to apply wherever candidate sets are generated, and every decision comparison uses the PREFERENCE (candidate, dominated, deciding, decided_by_physical_gain) rather than the full record, since `readiness` and `unresolved` legitimately differ when depth does.
out_of_scope: No change to `decide_promotion`. No uncertainty-calibration capability is built here — if one is needed, that is the finding. No realization-aware cost; REALIZATION-COST-1 follows this rung and not the other way round.
